summary: Fan out the public ride sync over CAROL's four concrete workout-family endpoints while retaining one ride store.
reason: Printing Press selects one list endpoint per resource for sync, but CAROL partitions ride history across four fixed paths; source generation alone would omit three families or expose generator-internal resource names. Generic sync also omits endpoint-default query parameters, while CAROL's canonical family request contract requires v=3.9.1.
validated_outcome: sync --resources ride requests only the four allowlisted family paths with the default v=3.9.1 query parameter, preserves explicit user overrides, paginates each from page 0, and stores stable IDs idempotently in the shared ride resource/table; MCP registers typed read-only tools for get-latest and every ride-list family.
